rules.rationale: All seven A13 commits import generated CTS/OpenGL CTS/Vulkan CTS mustpass lists from 2019 through 2022. Android 16 carries the current upstream layout under mustpass/main, including the 25Q4 roll and Vulkan CTS 1.4.1 integration. Its runners, README and Vulkan CMake files reference main rather than the removed A13 master snapshot paths. Restoring those old paths would create stale parallel test inventories rather than preserve BlueStacks product behavior.
rules.necessity: Not necessary for the guest runtime or build. Current conformance data must stay aligned with the Android 16 dEQP binaries and test harness.
rules.performance: Avoids packaging and indexing hundreds of obsolete generated test-list files. There is no runtime performance effect because these are conformance-test inputs.
rules.security: Using the current upstream lists avoids false conformance results caused by pairing old case inventories with newer Vulkan/OpenGL test executables.
validation_evidence: A13 tracks 896 files below the reviewed mustpass paths, while AOSP16 and Android-16 each track the same 165-file current layout.
Android-16 external/deqp HEAD 250bcc254 is a 25Q4 snapshot and its history includes the upstream Vulkan CTS 1.4.1 merge.
Android-16 OpenGL runners and Vulkan README/CMake references resolve to mustpass/main; no build reference to the removed A13 vk-master-2022-03-01 or mustpass/master paths was found.
